title: CELEBRITY: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond, but he is a Jaeger-LeCoultre ambassador. Will 007 still wear Omega?
hook: The new 007 already has a watch deal. It isn't Omega.
why: Timely news the owner asked for. FACTS: Amazon MGM Studios announced Robert Pattinson as the seventh James Bond on 16 Nov 2026 (Amazon's own post: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/james-bond-robert-pattinson-cast-amazon-mgm-film ; Hollywood Reporter: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/robert-pattinson-landed-007-what-next-1236757722/). Directed by Denis Villeneuve, written by Steven Knight; no title or release date announced (one outlet says 2028: label as reported only). Pattinson became a Jaeger-LeCoultre global ambassador in Sept 2026, campaign on the Master Control Chronometre (WatchPro: https://usa.watchpro.com/robert-pattinson-named-jaeger-lecoultre-ambassador/ ; JLC: https://www.jaeger-lecoultre.com/ca-en/news/our-maison/ambassador-robert-pattinson). Omega has dressed Bond since GoldenEye (1995). Pattinson wore no watch in the announcement (Fratello, 17 Nov: https://www.fratellowatches.com/robert-pattinson-confirmed-as-the-next-james-bond-no-watch-in-sight-for-now/ ; WatchPro: https://usa.watchpro.com/robert-pattinson-james-bond-jaeger-lecoultre-omega/). Which watch he'll wear on screen is NOT confirmed: say so plainly, credit Fratello/WatchPro by name. SPOTLIGHT watch: Omega Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond Edition ref. 210.30.42.20.03.004, 42 mm steel, US$8,600 (Omega US site: https://www.omegawatches.com/en-us/watch-omega-seamaster-diver-300m-co-axial-master-chronometer-42-mm-21030422003004 ; launched 5 Oct 2026, Monochrome: https://monochrome-watches.com/omega-seamaster-diver-300m-james-bond-and-spectre-collection-2026-review-price/). SHAPE (owner): cover with Pattinson (free/credited photo) -> Watch Spotlight slide (the Omega Bond Edition, official photo, price) -> our take (Omega has 30 years and a contract; JLC has the actor) -> 'Your call: Omega or JLC on 007?' vote slide -> follow. No hedge-only slides.

verdict.reason: The check passes. I confirmed on Amazon's page that Pattinson was named Bond on 16 Nov 2026, and the Omega price (US$8,600, 21 Nov) matches the verified claim. The cover shows him in a Jaeger-LeCoultre press photo with a visible watch and a credit. The post ends on an Omega-or-JLC vote that invites comments.
